Meta.title: Antalya Canyon Ultra
Meta.description: Trail running through the canyons of the Taurus mountains — November 13-15, 2026

About.title: ANTALYA CANYON TRAIL
About.p1: With 70K, 45K, 33K, 13K, and 7K stages, Antalya Canyon Ultra brings together local and international athletes of every level in Antalya's unique nature.
About.p2: The courses pass through the captivating natural beauty of Güver Cliff, Güver Canyon, Kapuz Canyon, Karaman Stream, Cennet Valley, and around Doyran Pond, offering runners a technical and unforgettable trail experience. Runners will have the opportunity to explore the cultural heritage around the Doyran Monastery and the ancient city of Neapolis as they progress along the historic paths of the Lycian Way. Accompanied by the impressive views of the Beydağları mountains, this special event brings together nature, history, and adventure on the same course. Stretching between Lycian trails, ancient ruins, and the deep canyons of the Taurus mountains, these courses invite not only nature lovers but also those who want to explore a unique geography that has hosted legendary scenes of Turkish cinema over the years. Antalya Canyon Ultra invites athletes to become part of an unforgettable adventure from Güver Cliff to Kapuz Canyon.

antalya-termessos-ultra.description: Roughly 70 km long with 1935 m of elevation gain, the Antalya Termessos Ultra consists of 15% paths, 84% tracks and 1% roads.

antalya-goat-ultra.name: Antalya Goat Ultra
antalya-goat-ultra.description: Roughly 46.7 km long with 1037 m of elevation gain, the Antalya Goat Ultra consists of 8% paths, 91% tracks and 1% roads.

alageyik-trail.name: Alageyik Trail
alageyik-trail.description: Roughly 33 km long with 704 m of elevation gain, the Alageyik Trail consists of 5% paths, 94% tracks and 1% roads.

guver-cliff-trail.name: Güver Cliff Trail
guver-cliff-trail.description: Roughly 13.5 km long with 112 m+ of elevation gain, the Güver Cliff Trail consists of 3% paths, 96% tracks and 1% roads.

my-pace-run.name: My Pace Run
my-pace-run.description: Roughly 7.5 km long with 38 m+ of climbing, the My Pace Run consists of 6% paths, 90% tracks and 4% roads — ideal for families, young athletes and beginners.
